description: Utterance SFT (discrete SER) for the Hugging Face ALMs: LoRA on every q/k/v/o projection (exclude_modules only matches a module named exactly audio_tower, so the audio encoder's q/k/v carry LoRA too; its base weights are frozen), connector not trained. Used for the reported Qwen2-Audio and Audio-Flamingo-3 utterance adapters.
